title: Questbook
description: You dont need a questbook, you can open quests by pressing `
Quests are not required to progress, but offer some nice rewards.
You might consider completing all of them as one of your goals! :)
The shape of each quest has a meaning:
§2§lRounded Square§r§r - Main Questline in the progression. These might also unlock new quests.
§2§lGear§r §r-  Quests outside of the Main progression that unlock quests in other chapters (usually in the Market).
§2§lDiamond§r§r - Repeteable Quests, usually giving some nice items in exchange for currency.
§2§lPentagon§r§r - One-time purchases; exchange coins for rare and useful items.
